title: A Escolha de Owen
summary: Friday 2027-02-05. Arthur's fever subsides and he is clinically stable with encouraging signs, but remains in hospital. Owen decides to travel to Austin. Adrian decides on six Academy Green players instead of a bench for Main. Vincente gives an interview to ge.globo (published 19:14). Nathan is invited to a community workshop. IEM Dallas Feb 5 results: Vitality 2-0 Liquid, FURIA 2-1 MIBR, M80 2-0 BC.Game, paiN 2-1 Astralis.
keyEvents: 8:36 — Adrian: no one will be hired to sit on Main's bench; Academy Green will have six players (five starters plus one), with possible promotion if rules allow; Owen is not leaving Kairos Gaming; no public announcement.

9:42 — A Los Angeles community organisation tied to the programme that received the USD 20,000 donation invites Nathan to a technology workshop; conditions: no live broadcast, no use of players as an attraction without authorisation, compatible with study and training; Jacob and Zayn will help.
10:51 — ge.globo interviews Vincente (Palmeiras 2026 blue shirt); the article is published at 19:14.
11:37 — IEM Dallas Group A: Team Vitality 2-0 Team Liquid (Nuke 13-9; Dust II won by Vitality).
12:49 — Doctor: encouraging signs, no new fever, clinically stable, no safe forecast of discharge; Arthur tells Owen the decision must be his.
14:18 — Group A: FURIA 2-1 MIBR (Inferno MIBR 13-11, Overpass FURIA 13-7, Train FURIA 13-10).
17:26 — Group C: paiN Gaming 2-1 Astralis (Cobblestone Astralis 13-9, Cache paiN 13-8, Nuke paiN won after 10-8).
18:03 — Owen tells Adrian and Luk he wants to go to Austin and asks to be allowed to return, even during the tournament; they agree; the Sunday departure is kept.

20:07 — Owen confirms to the Main players on a call; 21:36 Emily's travel report: Main leave Los Angeles on 2027-02-07 with Owen; Arthur stays in hospital with logistical support; Marcus presents the first list of candidates for a sixth Academy Green player (none hired).
consequences: Glacier will travel to Austin with the five Kairos Gaming starters.
The sixth-player plan is redirected to Academy Green and stays unannounced.
canonIntroduced: Owen decides to play the CCT.
Vincente's ge.globo interview is published on 2027-02-05 at 19:14 (article in data/publications).
canonChanged: Episode 125's idea of a sixth player for the main team is replaced by a sixth Academy Green player.
continuityNotes: The in-episode table lists the day's results as Vitality 2-0 Liquid, FURIA 2-1 MIBR, M80 2-0 BC.Game, paiN 2-1 Astralis.
The ge.globo article text appears only as a headline, a standfirst and a summary in the episode; the full article in data/publications is a writing based strictly on the interview scene.
Vincente's Palmeiras shirt is green in Episode 122 and blue (2026) here.
realWorldReferences: ge.globo and Palmeiras are real-world references; the article is labelled in the episode as fictional reporting in the Kairos universe.
confirmedFacts: Vitality 2-0 Liquid; FURIA 2-1 MIBR; M80 2-0 BC.Game; paiN 2-1 Astralis (Group A and C, 2027-02-05).
Arthur is clinically stable with encouraging signs; he remains in hospital with no safe discharge forecast.
Owen travels to Austin on 2027-02-07 and may return if Arthur worsens.
Vincente's parents are from Curitiba; he grew up in Tulsa; he has never lived in Brazil.
unconfirmedDetails: Name of the journalist and of the ge.globo section, and who owns the community organisation behind the workshop.
notes: Kairos Gaming is the public name of the Counter-Strike Main team.
